reusable_now: literal numeric strings and evidence spans as candidate evidence
requires_contextual_adjudication: technology developer vs implementer vs user
judgment, client ownership, supervision and mentoring responsibilities
qualification_of_budget: Planning assumptions, not actual usage or a validated output-token cap
absence_rule: No rule hit is unknown; full-document nonmention is still not actual absence of requirement or task
validation: Reuse existing fixed eval80 for an independently reviewed bounded check; no new sample loop. Agreement/quote consistency is not human gold or population accuracy. Contextual output remains candidate until this check.
time_rule: URL MD5 identifies a URL, not a historical text version; no claim current wording existed at first-seen date.
population_rule: Frozen technology-prefiltered 2023-2026 sample; arm C is not a general untreated control; US-only and employer mapping not established.
stop_rule: No keyword retuning, no new inference model, no API spending, no bulk semantic labels from conversation agents this turn.
